title: Formulary
summary: FORM'ULARY, noun [from Latin formula.] 1. A book containing stated and prescribed forms, as of oaths, declarations, prayers and the like; a book of precedents. 2. Prescribed form. FORM'ULARY, adjectiv

inlines.v: FORM'ULARY, noun [from Latin formula.] 1. A book containing stated and prescribed forms, as of oaths, declarations, prayers and the like; a book of precedents. 2. Prescribed form. FORM'ULARY, adjective Stated; prescribed; ritual.
